## Audit scope and outcome

This is the K1 selection run, not a B0 baseline; no B0 trajectory is supplied, so no baseline behavior or knowledge adoption can be assessed. The supplied record says four capabilities were loaded, but behavioral matches do not establish that the library caused them: ordinary repository exploration and testing could produce the same actions. Capability text: `runs/capability_v1_selection_superjson-error-stack-serialization_K1_r1/infer_logs/superjson-error-stack-serialization/turn_1/loaded_capabilities.md`; events: the adjacent `trajs.json`. These paths are under `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-26/trajectory-to-capability-rsi-hint-rsi/outputs/trajectory_capability_20261126_020200/`.

**Formal outcome was partial, not full success:** official F2P was 79/80, P2P 116/116, binary reward 0. The sole reported F2P failure expected a cause error excluded by `classFilter` not to have its URL sanitized, but observed `inner [redacted]`. This is consistent with the final patch passing the root’s `sanitize` flag recursively even though it separately computes each cause’s `ownMatch`; the reported failure itself is the evidence, not proof of a broader failure mechanism. Source: `runs/capability_v1_selection_superjson-error-stack-serialization_K1_r1/eval_output/superjson-error-stack-serialization/eval_result.json`, also reproduced in the supplied formal evaluation.

## Exploration, changes, and checks

`main_agent` events 1–10 inspected repository status, instructions, package configuration and the error transformation/walker interfaces, and created branch `feat/error-stack`. Several read outputs were truncated, so their unseen contents cannot establish what was examined. Before editing, events 11–12 built and ran a public-interface frame example: it returned the ordinary `Error` annotation and failed the `Error/frames` assertion.

Events 15–28 created `/app/src/error-options.ts`, `error-stack.ts`, `error-sanitizer.ts`, and `error-class-registry.ts`, and extended `/app/src/index.ts` with options and a processor registry. Events 31–32 changed `/app/src/transformer.ts` to select error annotations and serialize/deserialize errors; the final supplied patch shows modes, allowlisted stack fields, cause handling, filtering, sanitization and `AggregateError` handling. Event 45 adjusted legacy cause deserialization. The committed patch was six files, 312 insertions and 33 deletions, commit `61e05d0` (events 51–52). Formatting also changed unrelated layout in `index.ts` (events 39–40, 50): extra diff and review work, though not shown to change behavior. The original task specification is not provided, so the necessity of each feature or the branch and commit cannot be independently judged.

Builds passed (events 30, 32, 40, 48). A focused frame/cause Map round trip passed (events 34, 36); further local checks covered modes, sanitization, nested Map/Set, a legacy plain cause and other cases (events 46–48). Parts of the latter command are truncated, limiting claims about its complete assertions. The local existing suite failed its performance test, 2143 ms against 700 ms, with 81 passed, one skipped and one todo (events 33, 35); no pre-change timing baseline establishes whether the patch caused that failure. The student accurately reported these local results in event 53, but did not claim official success. Local checks are distinct from the later official F2P/P2P results above.

## Capability-specific assessment and costs

1. **Trace across boundaries:** Direct behavior included inspecting transformer, public API and walker, then checking serialized annotation and nested collection round trips (events 3–10, 34–36, 46–48). This supports limited cross-boundary tracing, not complete coverage of consumers or error paths. Truncated reads and commands limit further assessment. No student claim of complete tracing appears.
2. **Reproduce and inspect:** Events 11–12 provide an executable failing pre-edit example, and events 34–36 check related output after editing. The exact original command was not visibly rerun; the later example is related but broader. Event 48 reports focused checks passed, not exhaustive unknown-input coverage. This is stronger evidence than the student’s summary claim in event 53, but the official class-filter failure shows its limits.
3. **Verify transformations beyond an example:** Executable checks included multiple modes, nested collections, causes and a local regression suite (events 33–36, 46–48). They did not visibly test repeated transformation or the failing mixed class-filter/cause case. Idempotence may not be the relevant contract for this serializer; no inference of its success or failure is warranted. Truncation prevents assessment of every focused assertion.
4. **Interpret and report precisely:** Event 53 distinguishes passing build/focused checks from the failed local performance test. The student did not visibly compare that timing to a baseline or explain its cause, and the record does not show it knowing the later official result. Its report was a claim corroborated by events 35–36 and 48, not a full-success claim.

The run ended normally with `end_turn`, not a budget or technical stop; metadata reports no technical errors. Costs were substantial: 26 requested and returned tool calls, 813,935 input and 5,324 output tokens, 838.901 seconds reported wall time, and $4.202775 reported SDK cost. The metadata also reports a different session wall duration of about 569 seconds; these should not be treated as the same measure.

| Capability/theme | Observed action | Agent/event IDs | Inference limit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Boundary tracing | API, transformer and walker inspection; nested round trips | `main_agent` 3–10, 34–36, 46–48 | Some output truncated; not full-flow coverage or causation by guidance |
| Reproduction | Pre-edit failed frame assertion; related post-edit check passed | `main_agent` 11–12, 34–36 | Original command not visibly repeated verbatim |
| Transformation verification | Multiple modes and regression suite | `main_agent` 33–36, 46–48 | No visible mixed-filter case; official F2P still failed |
| Precise reporting | Disclosed local performance failure | `main_agent` 35, 53 | No timing baseline; official results are separate |
| Extra work and outcome | Formatting, six-file commit; formal partial result | `main_agent` 39–40, 50–52; evaluation path above | Feature necessity and failure causes beyond reported evidence unknown |
